extracted.intended_audience: general public (journalists, supporters/donors, policymakers, people seeking help)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational 'About' page describing the Committee to Protect Journalists' mission, values, methods, programs, and how it protects journalists worldwide. Covers research, advocacy, emergency assistance, and organizational structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defend the right of journalists to report safely
rubrics_metrics.description: We defend the right of journalists to report the news safely and without fear of reprisal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core mission statement: CPJ mobilizes around attacks, imprisonment, and killings to protect journalists and allow them to report without fear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote press freedom worldwide
rubrics_metrics.description: The Committee to Protect Journalists is an independent, nonprofit organization that promotes press freedom worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Global mandate: CPJ's activities are framed as global and not limited to any single region or political system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research-based documentation of press freedom violations
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ’s work is based on its research, which provides a global snapshot of obstructions to a free press worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research staff document hundreds of attacks on the press each year; research underpins reporting, advocacy, and interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document attacks, imprisonments, and killings
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ’s research staff documents hundreds of attacks on the press each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ongoing data collection and case documentation are central activities used to inform advocacy and public reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Denounce press freedom violations publicly
rubrics_metrics.description: In our quest for a free media, CPJ denounces press freedom violations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public condemnation is used as a tool alongside other interventions to call attention to abuses.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-level advocacy and diplomatic engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ meets with heads of state and high-ranking officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct engagement with government leaders and officials is a tactic for advancing press freedom and seeking remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spearhead or advise diplomatic efforts
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ spearheads or advises on diplomatic efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CPJ either leads or supports diplomatic initiatives aimed at resolving press freedom violations or securing journalists' release and safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with partner organizations to pursue justice
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ works with other organizations to ensure that justice prevails when journalists are imprisoned or killed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coalition-building and partnership are emphasized for legal, diplomatic, and advocacy efforts to achieve accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide safety and security information and rapid response assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ provides comprehensive, life-saving support to journalists and media support staff working around the world through up-to-date safety and security information and rapid response assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational support includes safety guidance, emergency help, and quick interventions intended to protect journalists at immediate risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report impartially across contexts
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ reports on violations in repressive countries, conflict zones, and established democracies alike.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage is presented as non-selective and global, documenting press freedom issues regardless of regime type or region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobilize a network of correspondents for reporting and action
rubrics_metrics.description: When press freedom violations occur, CPJ mobilizes a network of correspondents who report and take action on behalf of those targeted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A distributed correspondent network enables local reporting, verification, and rapid mobilization in response to incidents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain an expert, global staff and governance
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ is made up of about 40 experts around the world, with headquarters in New York City. A board of prominent journalists from around the world helps guide CPJ’s activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational capacity and credibility are conveyed through staff expertise and an internationally-recognized board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide public-facing services and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ offers safety resources, data (Journalists Killed, Journalists Imprisoned, Missing Journalists), FAQs, emergency help guidance, and email alerts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining accessible tools, data, and communication channels is part of CPJ’s service model for journalists, researchers, and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate as an independent nonprofit with legal/financial transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: CPJ is a 501(c)3 non-profit. Our EIN is 13-3081500.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal nonprofit status and published contact information signal organizational legitimacy and avenues for donations/support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish under clear licensing and permissions terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Except where noted, text on this website is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License. Images and other media are not covered by the Creative Commons license.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content reuse conditions and media permission rules are explicitly stated; FAQs provide more information on permissions.
